method: Read-only stdlib census; no upstream imports, installers, tests or APIs executed. Scope labels identify review depth, not a line-by-line audit.
limitations: All seven unique skill entrypoints received semantic review. Selected algorithm/persistence/preview/distribution mechanisms reviewed statically. Dataset census parses every CSV row but does not validate every factual recommendation. Other references, test fixtures, images, translations and gallery assets are inventoried, not all manually reviewed.
No upstream code, installers, dependencies, unit tests, APIs, browser previews or font downloads executed. No comparative model efficacy or product usability experiment performed.
